product_family: Merchant of Record platform for digital product companies. Key sub-products: Paddle Billing (MoR payments, subscriptions, localized checkout, tax compliance), ProfitWell Metrics (subscription/revenue analytics), Retain (failed payment recovery and churn reduction), Paddle Classic (legacy platform).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Current Documents: 2025 - SOC 2 Type II. Archived Documents: 2024 - SOC 2 Type II; 2023 - SOC 2 Type II. Scope: Security, Availability and Confidentiality trust services criteria.

certifications.name: PCI DSS 4.0.1
certifications.proof_quote: Current Documents: 2026 - PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance. Archived Documents: 2025 - PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance. PCI DSS 4.0.1 listed as compliant on trust center.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR listed as compliant on trust center. GDPR readiness page describes lawful processing, data subject rights, SCCs for international transfers, and DPA available.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA listed as COMPLIANT on the Paddle Trust Center overview page.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 certification on trust.paddle.com or any paddle.com domain page. A Paddle compliance blog post describes ISO 27001 as something SaaS companies 'might also need' - indicating Paddle does not hold it. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claims this cert but provides no vendor-domain evidence. Unknown / no public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA on trust.paddle.com or paddle.com domain. Paddle is a payment/billing platform not serving healthcare use cases. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claims HIPAA compliance but no vendor-domain evidence supports this. Unknown / no public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of FedRAMP on trust.paddle.com or paddle.com domain. Paddle is a UK-incorporated commercial payment company. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claims FedRAMP compliance but no vendor-domain evidence supports this. Unknown / no public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of CSA STAR on trust.paddle.com or paddle.com domain. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claims CSA STAR Level 1 but no vendor-domain evidence supports this. Unknown / no public evidence on Paddle's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on Paddle's own domain. Paddle is primarily a payments platform, not an AI product.

privacy.ai_training_note: Paddle is a Merchant of Record payments platform, not an AI product. The privacy policy, Master Services Agreement, and Data Processing Addendum contain no provisions regarding AI model training on customer data. The 'Lovable Payments, powered by Paddle' feature listed on the homepage appears to be a partner integration, not an Paddle-owned AI product. No AI training concerns identified.
privacy.data_region: Primarily United States (AWS cloud hosting for Paddle SaaS platform). EU/Ireland (Snowflake for business intelligence/analytics). Personal data may be transferred internationally among Paddle entities in UK, US, Ireland, and Canada per privacy policy. Standard Contractual Clauses used for EU-to-non-adequate-country transfers.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes - industry best practices including TLS encryption in transit confirmed

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: Yes - MFA supported for platform access (referenced in trust center FAQ)

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing. 2025 pentest report available in trust center documents.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Access control policies in place per DPA Exhibit B security measures

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: Responsible disclosure policy referenced in trust center FAQ

security.name: Status page
security.value: Public platform status reporting confirmed (referenced in trust center FAQ)

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Amazon Web Services (US) as primary cloud hosting provider for Paddle SaaS platform

security.name: Trust center platform
security.value: Vanta-powered trust center. Migrated from legacy SafeBase trust center (security.paddle.com) in January 2026.

products.name: Paddle Billing
products.data_scope: Payment card data (PCI DSS in scope), buyer PII, transaction records, subscription data, tax compliance data
products.notes: Full MoR model - Paddle assumes merchant liability and handles payments, taxes, and regulatory compliance across 300+ markets. PCI DSS 4.0.1 certified.

products.name: ProfitWell Metrics
products.data_scope: Subscription and revenue metrics, aggregated billing data
products.notes: Real-time subscription, retention, and growth metrics. Analytics data processed through Snowflake in EU (Ireland).

products.name: Retain
products.data_scope: Payment method data, customer billing records
products.notes: Automated failed payment recovery and cancellation reduction. Operates on payment and subscription data within the Paddle platform.

products.name: Paddle Classic
products.data_scope: Same as Paddle Billing - payment, PII, subscription data
products.notes: Legacy platform. SOC 2 2023 audit covered Paddle Platform Services including Classic. Customers migrating to Paddle Billing.

compare.pricing_model: Percentage-based transaction fee on processed revenue (standard rate published on pricing page). Custom enterprise quotes available. No separate per-product tier pricing for compliance features - all handled at platform level.
compare.data_residency: US-primary (AWS). EU/Ireland for analytics (Snowflake). No customer-selectable data residency option identified.

flags: Nudge Security, a third-party aggregator not affiliated with Paddle's domain, lists ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 as held by Paddle. None of these appear on trust.paddle.com or any paddle.com page.

trust.paddle.com lists only SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0.1, GDPR, and CCPA; ISO 27001 is absent. Paddle's own compliance blog post describes ISO 27001 as a certification SaaS companies 'might also need,' implying Paddle does not hold it.
Paddle is a UK-registered commercial payments platform, not a healthcare or federal government contractor. There is no basis for HIPAA or FedRAMP claims on the vendor's own domain.
Paddle is a Merchant of Record payment platform, not an AI product. The 'Lovable Payments, powered by Paddle' homepage callout is a partner integration, not a Paddle AI feature.

Paddle has both a 'Data Processing Addendum' (paddle.com/legal/data-processing-addendum, where Paddle acts as processor) and a 'Data Sharing Addendum' (paddle.com/legal/data-sharing-addendum, controller-to-controller). Both should be reviewed for enterprise procurement.
